meta.title: A saved eRFX draft: with lock_vendors_addition_in_event_creation Off, "Participants" is not offered

steps.note: Enable eRFX project creation for the draft.
Set the condition under test so vendor addition is locked during event creation.
Apply the additional configuration specified for this scenario.
Give the draft a searchable title.
Create an eRFX draft with an RFQ stage rather than the default auction stage.
Apply a pricing template required for the draft setup.
Add a line item so the draft has a valid pricing configuration.
Complete the pricing sheet before saving the draft.
Commit a schedule so the draft setup is complete.
Save the configured eRFX as an unpublished draft.
Confirm the draft save did not produce an application error.
Navigate to the events list to reopen the saved draft.
Confirm the created draft is present in the Drafts tab.
Open the draft under test from the Drafts list.
Assert that Participants is not offered on the reopened draft when vendor addition is locked off.
